text: Either party may end this agreement by giving 7 days' notice in writing.
notes: Reasonable, mutual notice period.

text: कोई भी पक्ष ७ दिन पहले लिखित सूचना देकर यह अनुबंध समाप्त कर सकता है।
notes: Hindi equivalent.

text: The lender can end this loan agreement anytime and demand full payment immediately, without notice.
notes: One-sided, no notice at all - favors lender entirely.

text: जमींदार किसी भी समय बिना किसी सूचना के जमीन वापस ले सकता है।
notes: Landowner can reclaim land anytime with zero notice - leaves cultivator with no security.

text: Any dispute about wages will be resolved by the local Gram Panchayat or Labour Officer.
notes: Proper, accessible venue named.

text: कोई भी विवाद होने पर साहूकार का फैसला ही अंतिम माना जाएगा।
notes: One-sided - the lender's word is 'final', denying the borrower any real recourse or court access.

text: Any disagreement about the crop share will be settled by mutual discussion, or before the village elder if needed.
notes: Reasonable informal resolution path, not one-sided.

text: This lease will automatically renew each year unless the tenant gives 30 days' written notice to cancel.
notes: Auto-renewal itself isn't automatically predatory, but deserves scrutiny - here the 30-day opt-out is fair, so flagged medium not high.

text: अगर समय पर पैसा नहीं चुकाया गया, तो कर्ज अपने आप अगले साल के लिए ब्याज सहित बढ़ जाएगा।
notes: Automatic loan rollover with compounding interest - a classic debt-trap mechanism, not a neutral renewal.

text: This contract will end after the harvest season and will not renew automatically; a new agreement must be signed for further work.
notes: Explicit, clean, no auto-renewal trap.

text: ब्याज हर महीने १०% की दर से बढ़ता रहेगा, चाहे जितना भी समय लगे।
notes: 10% per month compounding is almost certainly far above any reasonable notified cap.

text: Interest will be charged at the rate fixed by the government, reviewed annually.
notes: Compliant, different phrasing than the seed example.

text: मैंने राजू सेठ से १५,००० रुपये उधार लिए, जो मुझे ६ महीने में चुकाने हैं।
notes: Clear amount and term, different names/numbers than seed.

text: The full amount plus profit must be repaid within 7 days or the land will be taken.
notes: Unreasonably short repayment window plus harsh land-forfeiture consequence.

text: If the crop fails, the tenant must still pay the landowner's full share in cash.
notes: Shifts all crop-failure risk onto the tenant - not illegal outright, but a harsh, one-sided term worth flagging.

text: अगर मजदूर बीमार हो जाए तो उसे सूचित करने पर छुट्टी दी जाएगी, कोई जुर्माना नहीं।
notes: Fair sick-leave provision, no penalty.

text: The loan is for a fixed term of 6 months from the date of this note.
notes: Clear fixed term.

text: यह जमीन हमेशा के लिए खेती हेतु दी जा रही है, कोई निश्चित अवधि नहीं है।
notes: Indefinite/unclear duration is ambiguous and could blur into an unregistered ownership transfer over time.

text: Wages will be paid only at the end of the full 6-month contract, not before.
notes: Withholding all wages for 6 months is a serious risk pattern, close to wage bondage even if the daily rate is fair.

text: मजदूरी हर शनिवार को नकद दी जाएगी।
notes: Regular, frequent cash payment - healthy pattern.

text: काम के घंटे तय नहीं हैं, जब तक मालिक कहे तब तक काम करना होगा।
notes: No fixed hours at all - open-ended obligation is a strong risk signal, similar gap to the seed set's Rs 200/day example (no working-hours-cap provision yet exists in the legal corpus).

text: The cultivator has no ownership rights over the land; it remains fully owned by the landlord.
notes: Explicit and unambiguous - no risk.

text: अगर पैसा नहीं चुकाया गया तो कर्जदार की जमीन साहूकार की हो जाएगी।
notes: Informal land forfeiture on default, entirely outside any registered legal transfer process - a serious red flag regardless of whether the land is tribal.

text: The borrower's motorcycle is kept by the lender as security and will not be returned even after partial repayment.
notes: Refusing partial return on partial repayment is a harsh, one-sided term worth flagging even though pledging collateral itself is legal.

text: सोने की एक अंगूठी गिरवी रखी गई है, जो पूरा पैसा चुकाने पर वापस कर दी जाएगी।
notes: Fair, clear collateral terms.

text: No written record of the share percentage was given to the cultivator; it was only agreed verbally.
notes: Verbal-only Batai terms are exactly the documentation gap flagged as a priority in the sample-documents manifest's 'next batch' recommendations.

text: मजदूर को अनुबंध की एक कॉपी हस्ताक्षर सहित दी गई।
notes: Worker given a signed copy - good practice.

text: बटाई अनुबंध
notes: Document title.

text: Witness: Ramu, resident of Rehti village
notes: Administrative witness line.

text: दिनांक: १ अगस्त २०२६
notes: Date line.
